---
title: "Lab 07 — Randomized experiments"
output: learnr::tutorial
runtime: shiny_prerendered
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(tidyverse)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("../R/lab_submission.R")
exp <- read_csv("data/diplomacy_experiment.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
lab_meta <- list(id = "lab07", title = "Randomized experiments")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "What was randomly assigned in this teaching experiment?",
  q2 = "The difference in mean post-support (message minus control) is about…",
  q3 = "Under random assignment, that difference estimates…",
  q4 = "Name one thing this estimate does not automatically give you."
)
```

## What you will do

Read a difference in means as an effect of assignment. Download the `.txt`.

```{r means, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=6}
exp |>
  group_by(treatment_message) |>
  summarise(mean_y = mean(post_support_diplomatic_cooperation), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("A diplomatic message (treatment_message).", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Support for cooperation after the message."),
  answer("The participant's age."),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("0.8 points on the support scale (about 5.85 vs 5.03).", correct = TRUE),
  answer("8 percentage points of turnout."),
  answer("Zero. Randomization forces the means to match."),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  answer("The average effect of being assigned the message, in this sample.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("The effect of actually reading and agreeing with the message, for every diplomat."),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q4}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q4"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "External validity, perfect compliance, or a mechanism.",
  trim = TRUE
)
```

## Submit

```{r submit-ui, echo=FALSE}
shiny::textInput("student_name", "Your name", placeholder = "Name Surname")
shiny::downloadButton("download_txt", "Download submission .txt")
```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {
    write_lab_submission(
      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = shiny::reactiveValuesToList(learnr::get_tutorial_state()),
      prompts = lab_prompts
    )
  }
)
```
